Data Export

Export project data to various formats including Excel, Primavera P6, and Microsoft Project.

export

Export API Router.

This module provides API endpoints for exporting GUI views to PNG images and PowerPoint slides, and for generating template-based reports in Word and PowerPoint formats.

Endpoints

  • POST /api/v1/export/view — Export a GUI view to PNG or PowerPoint.

  • POST /api/v1/export/report — Generate a template-based report.

  • GET /api/v1/export/templates — List available report templates.

  • GET /api/v1/export/view-types — List supported view types.

Security

All endpoints require JWT authentication. The caller must have sufficient clearance to access the data being exported. Classification markings are automatically applied to exported documents.

Usage

# Export a view to PNG POST /api/v1/export/view { “view_type”: “dashboard”, “format”: “png”, “project_id”: “uuid” }

# Generate a Word report POST /api/v1/export/report { “template_type”: “programme_status”, “format”: “docx”, “project_id”: “uuid” }

What You Can Do

Viewing Information

  • View: List available report templates.

  • View: List supported view types for export.

Creating New Items

  • Create: Export a GUI view to PNG or PowerPoint format.

  • Create: Generate a template-based report in Word or PowerPoint format.
